params.name: Gain
params.values: Value by which to multiply the input 1 (default) | real or complex-valued scalar, vector, or matrix

params.values: Specify the multiplication mode Element-wise(K.*u) (default) | Matrix(K*u) | Matrix(u*K) | Matrix(K*u) (u vector)

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Interval between samples -1 (default) | scalar | vector
